selected_research_gap: Find and source-audit external primary mechanisms for manifest-bound closed-world completion/declared-input closure that can strengthen WP1200 without importing heavyweight frameworks or minting runtime credit.
hypothesis: A compact typed TargetObligationManifest bound by generation + canonical digest + exact mandatory obligation IDs, with report coverage checked as exact-set equality (or an explicitly typed superset policy) and missing IDs mapped to UNKNOWN, can close the PR415 negative-space class while remaining deterministic and cheap.
counterhypothesis: A manifest object adds complexity but does not close the bug if callers can mint, substitute, incompletely scope, or mismatch the manifest; the useful external lesson may be producer/admission binding and declared-input closure rather than the manifest data structure itself.
next_discriminator: E1 source archaeology across primary build/execution/control-plane mechanisms that bind results to declared inputs/spec generations; then map only invariant-level lessons into an F2-specific E2 design and reproduce the sparse-subset counterexample against a minimal synthetic manifest checker before any Trigger-4 handoff.
